title: PhD in Computer Science
institution: Singapore Management University, School of Computing and Information Systems
about: Singapore Management University's School of Computing and Information Systems accepts applications to its Computer Science PhD for the August 2027 intake from 1 August 2026 to 31 January 2027. SMU research scholarships cover tuition and a monthly stipend, for up to four years.
requirements: Online application with a one-time non-refundable fee of S$15 (incl. GST)
Early applicants may receive an early offer
